card.name: Numbers and grades in dose-adjustment rules
card.fires_on: Digits, spaces and punctuation inside numbers in dose-modification tables, such as grade levels, percentages, day counts and section references. Also drug-name pieces in withhold or discontinue instructions.

modes.label: Inside numbers
modes.description: A digit, decimal point or space within a number in a dose-reduction or lab-threshold rule.

modes.label: Space before grade or count
modes.description: The space after Grade or a comparison sign, right before the number.
modes.example: Withhold fluorouracil until Grade<< >>4 myelosuppression resolves;

modes.label: Inside drug name in stop rules
modes.description: A piece of an oncology drug name in a withhold or discontinue instruction.
modes.example: Permanently discontinue<< TE>>PMETKO if ILD is confirmed
